content:
Hi @Cheng Shi, @Philip Durbin, and team :wave:

Starting this thread to discuss issue #1073 (https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse-frontend/issues/1073).

Context: While reviewing the file upload flow in UploadedFilesList.tsx, I noticed a couple of TODO comments:

TypeScript

// TODO - Remove the file from the S3 bucket we need an API endpoint for this.

Currently, when files are directly uploaded to S3 and a user later clicks "Remove" (X) or "Remove Selected" from the staging list before saving the dataset, the files are cleared from the frontend form state, but the uploaded objects remain orphaned in the S3 bucket.

Discussion Points:

  1. Should we introduce a backend endpoint in core Dataverse to explicitly delete/abort uncommitted direct upload items?

  2. Or is the intended architecture to rely on S3 lifecycle rules / bucket expiration policies for unreferenced/temp objects?

Would love to hear your thoughts on how we should approach this!
